_metadata.author: claude-session (included allowance, no API)
_metadata.rules: One-word hints only (initialisms allowed). A hint never equals either target. About three strong hints per pair is a soft goal, never a quota or cap; a pair with one hint, or only a stretch, is kept and labelled. 'stretch': true is the author's honest flag that a link is indirect. Rejected lists hold genuine near-misses only (no CORE/PIE/CIDER-style filler). US audience, PG / non-graphic.
